module.purpose: Provides shared board resolution, snapshot loading, browser-rendered thumbnail capture, geometry measurement, cache writes, render-token lifecycle, and telemetry for thumbnail and OG-image pipelines.
module.summary: This module centralizes the render pipeline used by MCP screenshots, OG-image requests, and queue consumers. It resolves published and shared-file boards under explicit access gates, loads snapshots, signs short-lived render jobs, invokes either Cloudflare Browser Rendering or a local screenshot service, enforces delivery timeouts, records browser-session spend, and cleans up render tokens and measurement artifacts. It also writes PNGs and shared request telemetry while preserving cache-version and analytics conventions.
module.businessContext: Supports public previews, thumbnails, and social-image generation for tldraw boards. Failures can expose stale or private content, break previews, waste browser-rendering spend, or corrupt operational analytics.

typeShapes.name: ResolvedThumbnailBoard
typeShapes.shape:
{
	version: string | number
	/**
	 * The gate this board was resolved under, carried so a render cannot be minted under a weaker one
	 * than the resolution used. `captureThumbnailScreenshot` signs it into the job, and the snapshot
	 * route reads the board back under it.
	 */
	access: ThumbnailBoardAccess
	/**
	 * The `file` row this resolution gated on, for `shared_file` boards only. Carried so a caller that
	 * reads the snapshot in the same breath can hand it back to `loadBoardSnapshot` instead of asking
	 * Postgres the same question twice — see the `file` option on `getSharedFileRoomSnapshot` for when
	 * that is and is not appropriate. Never signed into a render job: the job carries the gate, and a
	 * row that travelled inside a token could not be re-checked on the way back.
	 */
	file?: SharedFileInfo
}

units.name: getRenderOrigin
units.source:
* separable.
 *
 * A token minted without a record fails its own check at the snapshot route and surfaces as a generic
 * render failure — and the way that arrived the first time was exactly this: a second mint site that
 * did the first half only, leaving every measure token unrecorded. Both mint sites go through here so
 * a third cannot repeat it.
 *
 * Recorded before the browser can present the token, so the snapshot route can tell one we minted from
 * one merely signed with our secret. Awaited, not fired off: the render is about to depend on it

async function callLocalScreenshotService(
	serviceUrl: string,
	requestBody: ThumbnailScreenshotRequestBody
): Promise<TimedCapture>
preconditions: serviceUrl identifies a fetchable HTTP endpoint.
requestBody is a valid ThumbnailScreenshotRequestBody.
postconditions: A POST request is sent to serviceUrl with the request body JSON-encoded.
A successful response is accepted only when its content type includes image/png.
A non-OK response or a successful non-PNG response causes the returned promise to reject.
invariants: The request uses Content-Type application/json.
The elapsed capture timing begins immediately before the fetch request.
edgeCases: When the HTTP response is not OK, the function throws an Error containing the numeric status and the response text.
When an HTTP 200 response has no content-type header, it is rejected because the content type does not include image/png.
When a successful response has a content type other than one containing image/png, it is rejected rather than treated as a thumbnail.

raises: Error with message `Local screenshot service failed (${response.status}): ${await response.text()}` for non-OK responses
Error for successful responses whose content type does not include image/png
errorPolicy.onInvalidInput: The promise rejects if the service response is unsuccessful or is not identified as a PNG image.

detail.ioFormatSpec: HTTP POST to serviceUrl with headers { "Content-Type": "application/json" } and body JSON.stringify(requestBody). Successful responses must have a Content-Type header containing image/png.
detail.summary: Posts a thumbnail screenshot request to the local screenshot service and processes the service response using the production-compatible capture path. It rejects unsuccessful responses and successful responses that are not PNG images.

specLiterals.role: Error message format for non-OK screenshot-service responses.
Request Content-Type header.
Required substring in the successful response Content-Type header.
HTTP method used for the screenshot-service request.

specTests.when: callLocalScreenshotService is invoked for that service URL.
specTests.then: The returned promise rejects with an Error whose message is `Local screenshot service failed (503): unavailable`.
The returned promise rejects instead of treating the response as a thumbnail.
The returned promise rejects instead of accepting the response as a PNG thumbnail.

units.name: measurePageShapes

detail.name: measurePageShapes
preconditions: env.THUMBNAILS is configured.
board contains the resolved kind, slug, version, and access values required to construct a thumbnail render job.
surface is a valid ThumbnailRenderSurface.
postconditions: A measure-mode thumbnail render job is minted and rendered using the board resolution and requested page.
On success, the stored render result is parsed as JSON and returned as a Record<string, ShapeMeasurement>.
Temporary render artifacts are cleaned up on both success and failure paths.
invariants: The render job uses mode 'measure', access from board.access, theme 'light', zoom 1, x 0, and y 0.
The render job uses DEFAULT_THUMBNAIL_WIDTH and DEFAULT_THUMBNAIL_HEIGHT for both its viewport and browser-render dimensions.
The browser session telemetry source is 'mcp' and its mode is 'measure'.
The render token expiration is set to the current time plus THUMBNAIL_RENDER_TOKEN_TTL_MS.
The render result is looked up using the key derived from the minted token.
edgeCases: When env.THUMBNAILS is absent, the function throws before minting a token or starting a browser-rendering session.
When the render result is absent from the thumbnails bucket, the function throws instead of returning an empty measurement record.
When the stored result is not valid JSON, JSON parsing throws and the cleanup path still runs.
A page with no shapes is represented by whatever empty measurement record the render result endpoint stores; the function does not synthesize measurements locally.

raises: SyntaxError from JSON.parse when the stored result is invalid JSON

stateMutations: Mints and records a measure-mode render token through the thumbnail render pipeline.
Starts a browser-rendering session whose measurement result is written to the thumbnails result store.
Cleans up temporary render artifacts in the finally path.
eventsEmitted: A browser_run_session spend-ledger record with mode 'measure' is written at the render choke point.
detail.ioFormatSpec: The stored render result body must be JSON representing Record<string, ShapeMeasurement>; the parsed object is returned unchanged.
detail.summary: Measures every shape on the specified page through a browser-rendering session and returns measurements keyed by shape ID. The render session is driven through the thumbnail pipeline and its measurement result is read from the configured thumbnails bucket.

specLiterals.role: Identifies the render job and browser session as a shape-measurement operation.
Identifies the telemetry source for the measurement browser session.
Specifies the theme used for page layout during measurement.
Error raised when the required thumbnails bucket is unavailable.

specLiterals.value: The render page did not report any measurements
specLiterals.role: Error raised when no measurement result is found for the rendered page.

specTests.then: It throws an Error with message 'THUMBNAILS bucket is not configured' before starting the render.
It returns the parsed measurement record keyed by shape ID.
It throws an Error with message 'The render page did not report any measurements'.

units.name: putThumbnailPng

detail.name: putThumbnailPng
preconditions: The environment, job, token, and result key supplied to the cleanup operations are valid for the current render.
postconditions: The minted render token cleanup operation is awaited.
An attempt is made to delete the thumbnail result object from env.THUMBNAILS using the supplied key.
Errors from deleting the thumbnail result object do not escape this cleanup operation.
invariants: Failure of thumbnail object deletion does not replace the measure's real answer or real error with a cleanup failure.
edgeCases: If env.THUMBNAILS.delete(key) rejects, the rejection is ignored and the function completes normally.
Concurrent measures use their own token-keyed records and result objects, so cleanup targets only the supplied token and key.

errorPolicy.returnsOnError: When deletion of the thumbnail result object fails, the error is swallowed and no error is returned from that cleanup step.

stateMutations: Deletes the minted render token through deleteMintedRenderToken.
Attempts to delete the thumbnail result object identified by key from env.THUMBNAILS.
detail.summary: Performs best-effort cleanup of a minted render token and its thumbnail result object. Cleanup failures for the thumbnail object are suppressed so they cannot replace the measure's original result or error.

specTests.when: The thumbnail cleanup function is awaited.
specTests.then: The rejection from env.THUMBNAILS.delete is suppressed and the cleanup function does not fail because of it.

detail.name: writeScreenshotTelemetry
detail.signature: export function writeScreenshotTelemetry(env: Environment, data: { source: 'mcp' | 'og' | 'queue'; reason?: OgImageRenderReason; followUp?: boolean; cacheStatus: 'hit' | 'stale' | 'miss' | 'none'; callerHash?: string; failureReason?: string; rateLimitAllowed?: boolean }): void

parameters.name: data
parameters.type: { source: 'mcp' | 'og' | 'queue'; reason?: OgImageRenderReason; followUp?: boolean; cacheStatus: 'hit' | 'stale' | 'miss' | 'none'; callerHash?: string; failureReason?: string; rateLimitAllowed?: boolean }

preconditions: data.source is one of 'mcp', 'og', or 'queue'.
data.cacheStatus is one of 'hit', 'stale', 'miss', or 'none'.
env.MEASURE is available to the telemetry writer.
postconditions: One datapoint is submitted to the mcp_shared_board_screenshot dataset.
The emitted datapoint contains six blobs in the order source, cache, failure, rate_limit, caller, and reason.
invariants: The dataset name remains mcp_shared_board_screenshot.
No board identity is included in the emitted telemetry.
The caller hash is emitted only when rateLimitAllowed is false and callerHash is truthy.
An omitted rateLimitAllowed value is treated as allowed.
An omitted failureReason is represented as none.
An omitted reason is represented as none.
edgeCases: When rateLimitAllowed is omitted, the rate-limit blob is rate_limit:allowed.
When rateLimitAllowed is false and callerHash is present, the caller blob contains that hash.
When rateLimitAllowed is true or callerHash is absent, the caller blob is caller:none.
When failureReason is absent, the failure blob is failure:none.
When reason is absent, the reason blob is reason:none.
stateMutations: Submits telemetry to env.MEASURE through writeDataPoint.
detail.ioFormatSpec: Telemetry datapoint written to dataset mcp_shared_board_screenshot with blobs ordered as source:${data.source}, cache:${data.cacheStatus}, failure:${data.failureReason ?? 'none'}, rate_limit:${rateLimitAllowed ? 'allowed' : 'blocked'}, caller:${!rateLimitAllowed && data.callerHash ? data.callerHash : 'none'}, reason:${data.reason ?? 'none'}.
